title: Friday the 13th: Midterms and a Market Meltdown
titleZh: 黑色星期五：期中考与股市暴跌
description: On Friday the 13th, Steven talks about horror clips flooding his Xiaohongshu feed, a by-the-book midterm writing exam worth "negative one point," and why students need to cite their sources. He then covers a brutal week for tech stocks, including Jensen Huang stepping down as Nvidia CEO after three scandals broke in one week, and explains why he expects a V-shaped recovery.

sentences.zh: 内容速览
sentences.en: Episode Overview

sentences.zh: 今天的节目聊了十三号星期五、期中考试收官，还有股市疯狂的一周。
sentences.en: Today's episode covers Friday the 13th, the end of midterm exams, and a wild week in the stock market.

sentences.zh: 史蒂文先从小红书上冒出来的恐怖片说起，再讲到期中写作考试，以及他希望“年轻学者们”学会的引用规范。
sentences.en: Steven starts with a horror film that popped up on Xiaohongshu, then moves on to the midterm writing exam and the citation conventions he hopes his "young scholars" will learn.

sentences.zh: 后半段聊科技股暴跌，英伟达的黄仁勋因一周内曝出三桩传闻而卸任，以及史蒂文为什么觉得市场可能走出V形反弹。
sentences.en: The second half covers the tech stock crash, Nvidia's Jensen Huang stepping down after three rumors broke in a single week, and why Steven thinks the market may make a V-shaped rebound.

sentences.zh: 十三号星期五与“闹鬼”的推荐页
sentences.en: Friday the 13th and a "haunted" feed

sentences.zh: 十三号星期五总让人浮想联翩。
sentences.en: Friday the 13th always gets people's imaginations running wild.

sentences.zh: 史蒂文小时候，《十三号星期五》和《猛鬼街》风靡一时，可他只看过十几年前翻拍的一部杰森电影。
sentences.en: When Steven was a kid, Friday the 13th and A Nightmare on Elm Street were all the rage, but the only Jason movie he's seen is the remake from over ten years ago.

sentences.zh: 小红书是他在中国少数几个用得顺手的平台，可血腥的好莱坞恐怖片段总是冒出来。
sentences.en: Xiaohongshu is one of the few platforms in China he finds easy to use, but gory Hollywood horror clips keep popping up.

sentences.zh: 看上一分钟，推荐页就被塞满了。
sentences.en: Watch for just one minute, and the feed gets flooded with them.

sentences.zh: 于是他只好飞快地往下划，想把推荐页“清洗、回收、冲干净”。
sentences.en: So he has no choice but to swipe past quickly, trying to "cleanse, recycle, and flush" his feed.

sentences.zh: 期中考试：价值“负一分”
sentences.en: Midterm exam: worth "minus one point"

sentences.zh: 说到恐怖，期中考试总算结束了！
sentences.en: Speaking of horror, the midterm is finally over!

sentences.zh: 今天是90分钟的写作考试，多数学生四十五分钟左右就交卷了。
sentences.en: Today was a 90-minute writing exam, and most students handed in their papers after about forty-five minutes.

sentences.zh: 开考前，一位金融专业的学生还问能不能提前走。
sentences.en: Before the exam started, a finance major even asked if they could leave early.

sentences.zh: 不行，期中考试算一节课。
sentences.en: No, the midterm counts as a class.

sentences.zh: 那为什么还要考？
sentences.en: So why give the exam at all?

sentences.zh: 因为它恰好值“负一分”：不考就扣一分。
sentences.en: Because it's worth exactly "minus one point": if you don't take it, you lose a point.

sentences.zh: 有两个学生缺考，正是那两位想来才来上课的。
sentences.en: Two students missed the exam, and they were exactly the two who only come to class when they feel like it.

sentences.zh: 考卷上写的是至少350词，所以题目不难，大家发挥得不错。
sentences.en: The exam paper said at least 350 words, so the questions weren't hard, and everyone did well.

sentences.zh: 一丝不苟的考场
sentences.en: A meticulous exam room

sentences.zh: 史蒂文按正式考试的标准来：先在门外等候点名，不许用手机，Apple Watch 放进口袋，没听到指令不准碰试卷。
sentences.en: Steven ran it like a formal exam: wait outside the door for roll call first, no phones, Apple Watches go in pockets, and no touching the exam paper until instructed.

sentences.zh: 大家都很守规矩。
sentences.en: Everyone followed the rules.

sentences.zh: 他觉得，太松散学生就容易懈怠，事后又会抱怨：“明明有那么多练习机会，我怎么考得这么差？”
sentences.en: He feels that if things are too loose, students easily slack off, and afterward they complain: "I had so many chances to practice, so how did I do so badly?"

sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，他正努力不再叫学生“孩子们”，而是改称“年轻学者”。
sentences.en: By the way, he's trying to stop calling his students "kids" and call them "young scholars" instead.

sentences.zh: 学校每本答题册只给两张纸，工科学生要求加纸，其中一位正是练习作文被他批注“太长，删减”的那个。
sentences.en: The school provides only two sheets per answer booklet, and the engineering students asked for extra paper; one of them was the very one whose practice essay he had marked "Too long, cut it down."

sentences.zh: 也许工科学生天生有科学家的思维：“何不直奔核心，两三句话说清楚？”
sentences.en: Maybe engineering students naturally think like scientists: "Why not go straight to the core and say it clearly in two or three sentences?"

sentences.zh: 这话也有几分道理。
sentences.en: There's some truth to that.

sentences.zh: 评分与个人项目
sentences.en: Grading and Individual Projects

sentences.zh: 成绩暂时不能公布，得等所有老师批完。
sentences.en: Grades can't be released yet; they have to wait until all the teachers finish marking.

sentences.zh: 缺考的名单他会报给教学协调员。
sentences.en: He will report the list of students who missed the exam to the teaching coordinator.

sentences.zh: 课程评分如下：
sentences.en: The course grading is as follows:

sentences.zh: 雅思搭档对话： 带一位朋友来答疑时间。
sentences.en: IELTS partner conversation: bring a friend to office hours.

sentences.zh: 一分。
sentences.en: One point.

sentences.zh: 个人PPT： 两三分钟，最多四页。
sentences.en: Individual PPT: two to three minutes, four slides at most.

sentences.zh: 听众会把高深的学术词汇发到微信群里，史蒂文打算用这些词编一个搞笑的AI故事。
sentences.en: Listeners will send advanced academic vocabulary to the WeChat group, and Steven plans to use these words to make up a funny AI story.

sentences.zh: 一分。
sentences.en: One point.

sentences.zh: 期中考试： 一分。
sentences.en: Midterm exam: one point.

sentences.zh: 出勤： 一分。
sentences.en: Attendance: one point.

sentences.zh: 第五项： 依然是个谜！
sentences.en: Item five: still a mystery!

sentences.zh: 引用练习与AI检查
sentences.en: Citation practice and AI checking

sentences.zh: 史蒂文打算把期中口语考试逐字转写，发给每个小组去修改。
sentences.en: Steven plans to transcribe the midterm speaking exam word for word and send it to each group to revise.

sentences.zh: 然后让他们用AI对照五项标准（时间、成本、实施、公平和效果）检查。
sentences.en: Then he'll have them use AI to check it against five criteria (time, cost, implementation, fairness and effectiveness).

sentences.zh: 不过他说得很清楚：期末成绩不会用AI来评。
sentences.en: But he made it very clear: final grades won't be assessed by AI.

sentences.zh: 重点在引用：用了文章，就要写明作者和年份。
sentences.en: The focus is on citation: if you use an article, you have to state the author and year.

sentences.zh: 像“夏天越来越热”这样的常识则不用。
sentences.en: Common knowledge like "summers are getting hotter" doesn't need it, though.

sentences.zh: 如今AI代理能读文章、订酒店，“还有谁读东西呢？”
sentences.en: These days AI agents can read articles and book hotels — "who still reads anything?"

sentences.zh: 可我们照样做播客、开YouTube频道。
sentences.en: Yet we still make podcasts and run YouTube channels.

sentences.zh: 他一周内要批大约50篇作文。
sentences.en: He has to grade about 50 essays within a week.

sentences.zh: 生活琐事：天津、税款和Bluehost
sentences.en: Everyday matters: Tianjin, taxes, and Bluehost

sentences.zh: 这个周末，他们要去天津。
sentences.en: This weekend, they're going to Tianjin.

sentences.zh: 女朋友有大约一周年假，史蒂文却只有周六到周一。
sentences.en: His girlfriend has about a week of annual leave, but Steven only has Saturday to Monday.

sentences.zh: 周一他还得去北京银行办社保卡。
sentences.en: On Monday he also has to go to Bank of Beijing to get his social security card.

sentences.zh: 他每月交500美元社保和500美元税款：“太离谱了。还是说，只因为是我自己掏钱才觉得离谱？”
sentences.en: Every month he pays $500 in social security and $500 in taxes: "It's ridiculous. Or does it only feel ridiculous because I'm paying out of my own pocket?"

sentences.zh: 他还在网站续费前做备份。
sentences.en: He's also making backups before his website renewal.

sentences.zh: 原以为继续用Bluehost要花1300美元，结果发现自己订的是很高的套餐，现已取消勾选。
sentences.en: He originally thought staying with Bluehost would cost $1,300, but it turned out he had signed up for a very high-tier plan, which he has now unchecked.

sentences.zh: 股市下挫与黄仁勋风波
sentences.en: Stock Market Slump and the Jensen Huang Controversy

sentences.zh: 这是“十月惊喜”、季节性规律，还是AI热潮的终点？
sentences.en: Is this an "October surprise," a seasonal pattern, or the end of the AI boom?

sentences.zh: 美光六月见顶约1250，现在约798。
sentences.en: Micron peaked at about 1250 in June and is now around 798.

sentences.zh: 美光会加入SSAB股票清单，这是一份公开的谷歌表格，链接在节目说明里。
sentences.en: Micron will be added to the SSAB stock list, a public Google Sheet linked in the show notes.

sentences.zh: CoreWeave十月初约95，跌到45，现在回到约56。
sentences.en: CoreWeave was about 95 in early October, fell to 45, and is now back to around 56.

sentences.zh: 再说英伟达。
sentences.en: Now, on to Nvidia.

sentences.zh: 黄仁勋被曝三桩传闻，已不再担任CEO，财务长科莱特·克雷斯出任代理CEO。
sentences.en: Three rumors about Jensen Huang came out; he is no longer CEO, and CFO Colette Kress has stepped in as interim CEO.

sentences.zh: 有报道说，美国情报部门怀疑其中一位女性是间谍。
sentences.en: Reports say US intelligence suspects one of the women is a spy.

sentences.zh: 他也许确有不当之处，周日已道歉。
sentences.en: He may indeed have done something wrong, and he apologized on Sunday.

sentences.zh: 但在史蒂文看来，一周三桩传闻，像是一场有组织的围剿。
sentences.en: But to Steven, three rumors in one week looks like an organized attack.

sentences.zh: 如今到处是摄像头：“没图没真相。”
sentences.en: These days there are cameras everywhere: "No pics, no proof."

sentences.zh: RSI、SpaceX与V形反弹？
sentences.en: RSI, SpaceX and a V-shaped rebound?

sentences.zh: SpaceX回到139左右，接近135的发行价。
sentences.en: SpaceX is back to around 139, close to its 135 IPO price.

sentences.zh: 英伟达从240附近的双顶跌到最低150，现在约166，RSI为25，严重超卖。
sentences.en: Nvidia fell from a double top near 240 to a low of 150; it's now about 166, with an RSI of 25, heavily oversold.

sentences.zh: 那么，是丑闻所致，还是恐慌抛售？
sentences.en: So, was it caused by the scandal, or is it panic selling?

sentences.zh: 谷歌、CoreWeave和Meta在消息出来前就已下跌。
sentences.en: Google, CoreWeave and Meta had already fallen before the news came out.

sentences.zh: 标普500几乎没动，只是回落到200日均线：“典型的季节性回调，仅此而已。”
sentences.en: The S&P 500 barely moved, just dropping back to its 200-day moving average: "A typical seasonal pullback, nothing more."

sentences.zh: 这是“血流成河”的抄底良机，还是“接飞刀”？
sentences.en: Is this a "blood in the streets" chance to buy the dip, or "catching a falling knife"?

sentences.zh: 史蒂文不觉得会出现第二个雷曼兄弟。
sentences.en: Steven doesn't think there will be a second Lehman Brothers.

sentences.zh: 他的判断是V形反弹。
sentences.en: His call is a V-shaped rebound.

sentences.zh: 他的建议：写下“我之所以在这个价位买入（或不买）英伟达，是因为……”，免得日后自欺欺人。
sentences.en: His advice: write down "The reason I'm buying (or not buying) Nvidia at this price is because…" so you don't fool yourself later.

sentences.zh: 当然，这不构成交易建议，请咨询合格的理财顾问。
sentences.en: Of course, this is not trading advice; please consult a qualified financial advisor.

sentences.zh: 今日总结
sentences.en: Today's summary

sentences.zh: 即使是“负一分”的事，也要认真对待，并且该给的功劳要给。
sentences.en: Even something that's only "minus one point" deserves to be taken seriously, and credit should be given where it's due.

sentences.zh: 市场恐慌时，先把理由写下来，别让事后诸葛亮改写你的判断。
sentences.en: When the market panics, write down your reasons first, and don't let hindsight rewrite your judgment.

sentences.zh: 祝大家周末愉快，也祝史蒂文天津之行顺利！
sentences.en: Have a great weekend, everyone, and here's wishing Steven a smooth trip to Tianjin!

vocab.en: to be all the rage for a time
to encircle and crack down on
